summary.text: Christine O'Riley is the Republican candidate for the North Dakota State Senate, District 11, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Army veteran, she lists taxpayer relief, protecting life at every stage and parental rights among her campaign priorities.

paragraphs.text: Christine O'Riley served in the U.S. Army from 1981 to 2003.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she and her family returned to the home of her ancestors and settled in North Dakota after her service.
O'Riley advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
She said she wants to work to abolish or significantly contain property taxes, limit special assessments and examine abolishing the state income tax.
She also listed protecting life from conception to natural death, defending parental rights and veterans' issues as priorities.
